_comment: Token budgets, rate limits, and subscription tier config
_edit: Change subscription_tier to match your plan: pro | max | api
_field_note: This file uses subscription_tier; usage_budget.json uses subscription_type. Both refer to the same value — set CEK_SUBSCRIPTION_TIER env var to override.
_token_budgets_note: REFERENCE ONLY — nothing reads this block. The live thresholds come from
vars in settings.json; usage-tracker.py reads only subscription_tier from
this file. Kept because the windows below are the numbers you need when
reasoning about burn rate by hand.
Windows corrected 2026-09-13: Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 are 1M, not 200K.

pro.note: 5-hour rolling window. Compact proactively to stay within window.

max.note: 5x Pro limits — more headroom but same rolling window model.

api.note: Pure token billing. Cost is real. Monitor with /usage-forecast.

genomics_burn_rate_notes.recommendation: Use @file references. Never paste VCF/FASTA content inline.
